التقوا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَقَوْا (iltaqaw) /il.ta.qaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اُلْتُقُوا (ultuqū) /ul.tu.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اِلْتَقُوا (iltaqū) /il.ta.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
